facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT's sovereign cloud RFI names the Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Act (CCA) 2021 among the local regulatory compliance standards suppliers are to implement.

MUS.note: The sovereign cloud is a planned procurement (RFI); no data centre for hire in service is stated.

facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT's sovereign cloud RFI requires the cloud to abide by the Data Protection Act (named as Data Protection Act 2017).

The Ministry of ICT (MITCI) issued RFI MITCI/RFI/01/2025-26 seeking suppliers for a sovereign cloud for the Government of Mauritius, to be strictly governed by Mauritian law, under the government's total control and located in a Tier 3 equivalent or better local data centre.
facts.system: Sovereign Cloud for the Government of Mauritius

MUS.note: A request for information, not a procurement; no hosting or contract terms in service.
Document states nothing on national ID.
ISO standards are asked of suppliers; no national adoption, membership or public-body mandate stated.
No nationally owned data centre for hire in service is stated.
Disaster recovery is only an item in the supplier questionnaire; no backup site in a named place.
Document states nothing on a national standards body.
